alerts.title: F-Market Line Replaced by Buses, 11/24 - 11/26
alerts.description: SF Muni F-Market and Wharves Line will be replaced by bus shuttles starting on Tuesday, November 24 through Thursday, November 26, due to weather.

alerts.title: K-Ingleside, L-Taraval, and M-Ocean View Line Switching Back at West Portal Station
